Name: LGBTQ Pride Flags for Content Patcher (CP)
Author: eorrl
Description:
This mod replaces all of Lupini's paintings with pride flags of your choice. It is entirely configurable and includes a wide array of different flags.

All of Lupini's nine paintings can be configured to any of the following: the Philadelphia rainbow pride flag, the original rainbow pride flag from 1978, the Progress pride flag, the labrys lesbian flag, and the flags for transgender, bisexual, pansexual, lesbian, gay men, genderqueer, non-binary, genderfluid, agender, bigender (2 variants), genderfae, quoigender, pangender, demiboy, demigirl, demigender, voidpunk, trixic, toric, asexual, demisexual, demiromantic, nebulasexual, nebularomantic, aromantic, aroace, oriented aroace, cupioromantic, polyamory, queer, transfem, transmasc, and transneutral pride.

I originally included these flags in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8276]Custom Furniture LGBTQ+ Pride Flags[/url] mod, but made this mod since I know some people prefer Content Patcher / find it easier. The downsides of this are that the flags must be purchased from Lupini at the Night Market, and that you can only have a maximum of 9 flags, but it still includes the full variety of pride flags to choose from.

To install this mod, unzip directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder. After launching the game, you can assign any of the above flags to Lupini's paintings using the config file, or by using the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

Please note that if you install this content pack after you have already purchased Lupini's paintings, the appearance of the painting will change to the correct flag, but the painting's name might not.

Enjoy! :)

- Eorrl
